title: Quarterly Remittance Return of Final Income Taxes Withheld on Fringe Benefits Paid to Employees Other Than Rank and File

choice_rows.label: Item 13 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law or Tax Treaty?

validation.how: Red label only for non-numeric input (field() compares input keys to model keys); model messages go to the bottom 'Needs review' box, capped at 20; Queue is disabled at the top with no reason shown.

findings.now: The quarter from the dashboard tile stays clickable on the page, and choosing another quarter saves the return as a separate draft.
findings.why: A draft is stored under its own quarter and year (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:141), so the page's choice decides which row is written.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the period as a chip and change it only from the dashboard tile.

options.name: Combobox with warning
options.detail: Keep a picker, but warn before saving that another period opens a separate draft.

options.name: Lock after first save
options.detail: Allow changing the period only until a draft for that period has been saved.

findings.now: Only non-numeric entries turn a label red; a bad year, sheet count, name or amount shows only in the bottom 'Needs review' box, and Queue is disabled at the top without a reason.
findings.why: field() matches input keys such as 'sheets' and 'value0' against model keys such as 'number_of_attached_sheets' and 'monetary_value[0]' (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1603q.rs:539).

options.name: Pass the model error key
options.detail: Give field() an error key, as the 1604-C page already does with has_error(key, error_key).

options.name: Message beside the field
options.detail: Show each message under its own field, not only in the bottom panel.

options.name: Reason beside Queue
options.detail: Show the first blocking message next to the disabled Queue button.

findings.field: 15 — Tax remitted in return previously filed (amended only)
findings.now: After Item 3 changes to No, the disabled Item 15 box still shows the old amount, but Items 17 and 18 leave that amount out.
findings.why: The Item 3 buttons call edit() without reloading the money editors (form_1603q_view.rs:469-474), while recompute() zeroes the amount (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1603q.rs:264).

options.name: Reload on toggle
options.detail: Reload the money editors after Item 3 changes, as set_withheld() already does for Item 4.

options.name: Clear the box
options.detail: Blank the Item 15 text when Item 3 is No.

options.name: Hide when not amended
options.detail: Show Item 15 only when Item 3 is Yes.

findings.now: With Item 13 set to Yes and no 13A choice, Queue is blocked by 'Specify the tax relief on Item 13A.', a message the official 1603-Q never shows.
findings.why: The official validation has no 13A check (BIR-Form1603Qv2018.hta:2821-2904), so the page is stricter than the official form.

options.name: Drop the page-only rule
options.detail: Accept a blank 13A, which the page already writes as selTreaty value 0.

options.name: Keep and label it
options.detail: Keep the rule but show it as a page check rather than an official alert.

findings.now: The print preview shows the email in capital letters, although the stored email keeps the case typed.
findings.why: The print fill upper-cases writer-cell text joins and txtEmail is one (html-frozen/1603q-2018/writer-cells.json, p1c49), while the official capital() skips txtEmail (validation/package/js/string-util.js:241).

options.name: Skip the email in the upper-case step
options.detail: Exempt txtEmail in frozen_html.rs so print matches the stored value.

options.name: Named input on the sheet
options.detail: Give the frozen sheet a named txtEmail input so the join is not upper-cased.

options.name: Document the caps
options.detail: Keep the caps on paper and say on the preview that the email prints in capitals.
